description: Prior notification for demolition in relation to the link bridge and pedestrian stairs at 1 Lampton Road and the pedestrian stairs and associated access ramp at Central House
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The demolition must be completed within five years of the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed demolition shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the documents submitted (Cover letter from Montagu Evans; Location Plan; Method Statement; Site Notice Photos; (02) 000; Received on 27/06/2019; E-mail from agent; Received 22/07/2019.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - 3.	There shall be no HGV lorry deliveries to nor despatched from the site outside the following times: 9.30am until 3pm Mondays to Saturdays during school term times, otherwise 9.30am until 5pm Mondays to Saturdays; nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 4 - 4.	There shall be no barriers on the public highway for traffic management purposes. If such temporarily closures are required for the footway, there shall be a further permission from Hounslow Highways.
